title: Ines and the Safehouse
author: Isandro Almeida
blurb: Wendell Blackwood, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
